title: Define knowledge pack schema with trust labels and memory quarantine
purpose: Define knowledge packs as trusted or untrusted retrieval artifacts that cannot poison privileged AgentOS behavior.
scope: Represent trust labels, source provenance, TTL, content digest and allowed memory scope.
Define quarantine behavior for suspicious or untrusted content.
Define how knowledge enters planner context as bounded, labeled context.
acceptance_criteria: Knowledge pack cannot create approval claims.
Untrusted knowledge is quarantined or sanitized.
Raw secrets are rejected or redacted.
Planner context remains bounded and source-labeled.
failure_modes: Knowledge pack writes privileged policy instructions.
Suspicious content becomes long-term trusted memory.
